joints.handle_description: No handle; bowl-shaped porthole door 118 mm thick, black bezel nearly flush with the cabinet front, wide (~8 cm) rim, nothing to get fingertips behind

object_note: Front-loader style dryer, door hinged on -y (viewer-left) side swinging to +y. F marker is buried inside the bezel; door too thick and flush, heuristic 'ungraspable' is right.
